title: Extract ISO 8601 Dates
task_spec: Write a prompt that extracts all ISO 8601 dates (YYYY-MM-DD) from text and returns them as a JSON array, in order of appearance. Return only the JSON array, nothing else.
reference_solution_prompt:
Extract all ISO 8601 dates in the format YYYY-MM-DD from the following text. Return only a JSON array of the dates in the order they appear in the text. If there are no ISO dates, return an empty array []. Do not include any explanation or additional text — only the JSON array.

Text:

test_suite.hidden_input: The project started on 2024-01-15 and the deadline is 2024-06-30.
There are no dates in this sentence at all.
She was born on 2000-03-22 and graduated on 2022-05-14. Her first day at work was 2022-06-01.
Mix of formats: 12/25/2023, January 5th 2024, and 2024-03-15. Only ISO dates please.
Duplicate dates appear: 2023-07-04 was a holiday, and 2023-07-04 was mentioned again.
